newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary airport project loan gets government guarantee.
newsitem.headline: Hungary airport project loan gets government guarantee.

text.p: The Hungarian government will guarantee loans of an $103 million development project of Budapest's Ferihegy 2B terminal, an official said on Sunday.

"The development will result in a capacity increase of terminal 2A and 2B to a total 5.5 million passengers per year from the current two million," Sandor Gyurkovics, state secretary at the Transport and Telecommunications ministry, told a news conference.
The development tender was won by Canada's Airport Development Corp in 1994, but the original tender did not contain government guarantees.
Gyurkovics added that a government loan guarantee will result in improved financial conditions.

The 12-year loan, offered by a consortium led by CIB Bank, which took over this role from the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD), carries an interest rate of 0.95 percentage points above LIBOR.
The main contractor for the development will be the Canadian Commercial Corp (CCC), wholly-owned by the Canadian government, and CCC will pay the interest for the first two years, Gyurkovics said.
The new terminal is expected to be finished by mid-1998.
